title: FMLA leave for birth and bonding
facts: Eligible employees of covered employers may use FMLA leave for the birth of a child and bonding with the newborn.
Eligible employees may also use FMLA leave for placement of a child for adoption or foster care and bonding with the newly placed child.
FMLA bonding leave generally must be completed within 12 months after birth or placement.
Federal FMLA leave is generally unpaid, although paid employer leave or state paid-leave benefits may overlap when applicable.
